package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "net/http"
    "bytes"
)

func main() {
    
    req, err := http.NewRequest("GET", "https://eu.intouch.capillarytech.com/v2/customers/565261498?source=INSTORE&ndncStatus=true&optinStatus=true&slabHistory=true&tierUpgradeCriteria=true&membershipRetentionCriteria=true", nil)
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    
    req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
    req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Basic TYy")

    client := &http.Client{}
    resp, err := client.Do(req)
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    defer resp.Body.Close()
    
    fmt.Println("Response Status:", resp.Status)
}

require 'net/http'

request['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
request['Authorization'] = 'Basic TYy'

response = http.request(request)
